title: Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. translated_title: 冻结语言模型中基于自键参数内记忆化的无外部存储对话回忆方法
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.36948v1，通告类型：cross）：大型语言模型将对话内容保存在模型外部的一个存储中，该存储随着对话的持续而不断增长。本工作假设一个环境：语言模型没有任何外部存储，也不预先知晓未来的问题或其答案。研究动机是探究对话能否被存储在模型参数中，并在之后能够回答关于该对话的问题。本工作提出了自键参数内记忆化（Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization，SKIM），这是一种闭式解方法：模型针对每个对话轮次自行生成问题，并将这些问题作为键写入其参数中，以便日后检索该轮次的内容。为每个轮次生成多个多样化的问题，使得后续用户即使以不同措辞提问，也能与其中某个问题匹配，并仅从参数中召回答案。在五个语言模型上的评估表明，SKIM 能够通过后续的用户问题回忆起大多数已存储的对话轮次，并且它（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SKIM闭式方法，让冻结语言模型为每个对话轮次自生成问题作为键写入模型参数中，从而在无外部存储的条件下仅凭参数即可回忆对话内容并回答后续提问。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SKIM, a closed-form method in which a frozen language model self-generates questions for each dialogue turn and writes them into its parameters as keys, enabling dialogue recall and question answering from parameters alone without any external memory.
